notes:
A big update, and the largest change so far to how ChatsRecall handles your accounts.

## Highlights

- :person: **You decide which accounts are saved** When ChatsRecall finds an account you haven't answered about, a popup asks on whatever page you're on, and the Sync page's new Accounts list lets you stop or start saving from any account. A chat you open in your browser follows the same answer.
- :srcClaude: **Every Claude organization, pinned chats included** If you chat in more than one Claude organization, such as a personal plan and a work Team plan, each one is now its own account, and pinned chats come in with every sync.
- :link: **Connect Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor** Settings → Connect an agent makes a read-only access code with a ready-to-paste setup and a button to test it, so your assistant can search your archive.

> first sync, imports, Full sync, site changes, fixes

## Added

- Settings → Connect an agent: create an access code for Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor (read-only unless you also let it organize your projects), copy the setup it shows, and test the connection in one click. The same screen lists your codes, when each was last used, and Revoke.
- A "New AI account discovered" popup when a sync, or a chat you open in your browser, finds an account you haven't answered about: Approve brings its conversations in, Don't add keeps them out. If ChatsRecall is behind another window, it comes to the front for the question. Close the popup to keep the question in a small card in the corner until you decide.
- Sync page → Accounts: every account ChatsRecall saves from or was told not to, with Start saving and Stop saving. Neither deletes anything.
- Sync page: one line per AI with how many conversations were found, how many have their text, how many are still waiting, and about how long the rest will take.
- Claude: each organization you can chat in is its own account, with its own question, conversation count and Sync History line.
- Settings → Import takes many files at once; each becomes its own conversation, titled from its file name and dated by the file's date. Importing the same files again adds nothing twice.

## Improved

- A chat you open or type in your browser now follows "Don't save" for every AI, not only Claude, and a chat from an account nobody has answered about waits for your answer instead of being saved.
- Claude's pinned chats come in with every sync, not only a Full sync, and a chat you unpin in Claude loses its pin here.
- Each Full sync picks up where the last one stopped, so repeated Full syncs reach every conversation, older ones included, instead of re-reading the newest each time.
- Setup's first sync is a quick start: the newest 15 conversations from each AI you pick, your main one first, so you can search within a minute or two. Everything older follows by itself over the next hours.
- Setup's extension step names the two buttons to click in the store ("Add to Chrome", then "Add extension"), and ChatsRecall comes back to the front once the extension connects.
- Restarting ChatsRecall no longer disconnects a connected assistant, and from 0.1.97 on neither does an update. If you connected one on 0.1.96, restart it once after this update.
- When Google shows Gemini's "unusual traffic" check, the sync says so instead of failing without a reason.

## Fixed

- On a new install the first sync held every account for an OK and saved nothing. Accounts of the AIs you pick during setup are now saved without asking, and the ready card names them with a Not mine button.
- With two accounts for the same AI, a sync could remove the other account's projects (for ChatGPT with their chats) and add them back on the next run, so every sync reported new conversations while the library count stayed the same.
- Renaming, pinning, deleting and moving chats from ChatsRecall work again after recent changes to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Grok.
- Moving a Claude chat out of a project no longer reports done while the chat stays in the project.
- A very long conversation no longer cuts ChatsRecall off from your browser partway through a sync.
- A Claude chat you start in your browser is no longer sometimes saved empty.
- Meta AI conversations are read again after meta.ai changed how it loads messages.
- A Claude account's name no longer changes to its organization's name after you open one of its chats in your browser.
- Includes security fixes.
